details.description: This is Kimi K3, Moonshot AI's flagship open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model, released July 16, 2026. It uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 2.8 trillion total parameters and 104 billion activated per token, combining 69 Kimi Delta Attention layers with 24 Gated Multi-head Latent Attention layers and a 401-million-parameter MoonViT-V2 vision encoder, and it supports a 1,048,576-token context window with native text, image, and video understanding. Moonshot AI describes it as built for long-horizon coding, agentic knowledge work, and deep reasoning, with configurable reasoning-effort levels and native thinking.
advantages: Scores 93.5 on GPQA Diamond, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 88.3 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 91.2 on BrowseComp, indicating strong agentic tool-use and research capability, per its Hugging Face model card.
Supports native thinking with configurable reasoning-effort levels alongside a 1,048,576-token context window, per its Hugging Face model card.
Processes text, images, and video natively within a single model via its MoonViT-V2 vision encoder, per its Hugging Face model card and Moonshot AI's launch page.
use_cases: Long-horizon coding across large repositories and terminal-based tools
Agentic deep research and multi-step knowledge work with interactive visualizations
Multimodal reasoning over text, images, and video in extended contexts up to 1M tokens
Function calling and tool integration for agentic workflows

notes: The uri (fireworks_ai/accounts/fireworks/routers/kimi-k3-fast) is a Fireworks-specific serving tier, not a different model: Fireworks' own Kimi K3 model page explicitly lists 'kimi-k3-fast' as a latency-optimized deployment tier of the same Kimi K3 model, distinct from a regular deployment and from the 'kimi-k3-us' tier. Details above describe the underlying Kimi K3 model itself, per the research brief's instruction to describe the model rather than a host's serving details; no separate architecture, weights, or benchmark numbers were found specific to the 'fast' tier. Facts (context/output tokens, modality) match the kimi-k3 target exactly.
